name: The Eye of Bhossca
summary: A note for you waits in a chest. Its writer signs only with the initial C.

sections.title: The Note
sections.body: A chest holds a note addressed to you. Its writer says they will keep an eye out for you, then signs with the letter C.

faq.answer: The note is signed with the initial C; it gives no full name.
The writer tells you they will keep an eye out for you and signs with the initial C.
The note sits in a chest.
